summary: Ken McCoy's Jeep tumbled ~430 ft off the Radical Hill shelf road near Montezuma; ejected from the vehicle, he walked away with broken ribs, a forehead gash and a fractured nose; two ATV riders transported him out of the backcountry to medical attention; his dog survived with minor injuries.
location: Radical Hill shelf road, near Montezuma
responding_agency: Two ATV riders (transported subject to medical attention); Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery (vehicle recovery Aug 31, 8 volunteers, ~10 hrs at 12,300 ft); Summit County Sheriff and USFS notified
notes: Date 2017-08-22 pinned via the original co4x4rnr.org mission-reports category archive (report dated Sept 1, 2017, 'On August 22nd...'); the org's current homepage repost misdates the incident to 2019. No formal county SAR response reported — injured subject transported by passing ATV riders; the 4x4 group handled vehicle recovery only. Run 88 (4x4 rotation chunk).
